###==================================
### WELCOME TO TOUSATSU V0.3.1e mini
###==================================

###Instructions:
__You are Marta's son and with her you are also Lucy's brother living in the same house. You decided to spy on your family and in this game you will decide where to put the cameras on, What to do with the information that you gathered. You can blackmail, go to them in inappropiated moments, watch them, etc... The house is yours. But, be careful to not increase the stress bar too much or it will be GAME OVER. You are free to interact the way you want and to change camera you just need to write the related number, to choose the cameras you can just write all number in sequence (if some problem occurs try by separating them). If you want to continue a scene just write continue. You are free to move or zoom wherever you want. The bonus mode is a free roaming mode where you can't lose.__

###Known problems and tips:
__If you have some unexpected behaviour try to delete the MUST NOT section. If you want to change Actors secrets you can do so in the SECRET ACTION section (but try to play with the standard setting at first, so to not spoil actor's secrets. Sometimes AI can lose track of certain game rules. Please try regenerating the reply. If you want a more straightforward experience with less unexpected behavior, you can delete all elements related to STRESS LEVEL in both the prompt and dialogue examples, transforming it into a simple, story-driven narrative. Remember to give me some feedback, as this card is a complex game, AI behaviour can drastically change depending on the model. The more feedback I'd receive, the more controlled the behaviour will be.__



THIS IS THE MAIN MENU:
```
[1] : NORMAL MODE

[2] : BONUS MODE
```
